summary: Iteration 5 regression smoke after runtime pin changes (backend/runtime.txt=python-3.11.9, /app/.python-version=3.11.9, render.yaml PYTHON_VERSION=3.11.9). No code changed. Backend: 11/11 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_dinho_api.py PASS on Python 3.11.16 (health ok + database connected, admin login 200/401 JSON detail, quote multipart image upload + byte-for-byte /api/files/{id} retrieval + persistence, unknown file 404, invalid collection 404, admin CRUD on services, dashboard metrics auth guard, /api/public payload shape). Deploy resolution verified with `pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed -r requirements.txt`: clean resolution and, critically, pydantic-core 2.16.3 resolves to a PREBUILT cp311 manylinux wheel (no source build) - this confirms the Python 3.11 pin fixes the original Render 3.14 pydantic-core compile failure. pymongo==4.6.3 pin from iteration 4 still present. Frontend smoke on public URL: site loads (hero, services, images), quote form submits and shows quote-success-message, /admin login with real credentials reaches dashboard (16 leads / 11 quotes) with all tabs in sidebar; zero console errors, no error elements.

minor.issue: render.yaml sets rootDir: backend, but .python-version lives at repo root (/app/.python-version) and there is no backend/.python-version. Render resolves version files relative to the service root dir, so only backend/runtime.txt + PYTHON_VERSION env are actually effective. Harmless today (both agree on 3.11.9) but the root .python-version is dead config for the service - consider copying it to backend/ to avoid future drift.

issues: public/index.html still has the template <title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title> and meta description 'A product of emergent.sh' - should be Dinho Rodas branding/SEO copy (pre-existing, not a regression)

rca_of_the_issue: Render defaulted to Python 3.14, for which pydantic-core 2.16.3 publishes no wheel, forcing a Rust source build that fails on the free plan. Pinning to 3.11.9 makes pip pick pydantic_core-2.16.3-cp311-cp311-manylinux wheel, verified locally via dry-run. All application behaviour unchanged; full suite still green.
